title: Godot stops working when opening context menu
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.6 Beta 2

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta2 - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 4400 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-4160 CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads) - 11.55 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot simply stops responding after opening any context menu. It doesn't crash; the editor just stops working.

This has been happening for a while now, but it's so random that I have no idea why. Sometimes it happens frequently, and other times it doesn't. I also tried forcing its appearance by repeatedly opening context menus, and the editor stopped working after a while.

The video was recorded in a practically new project I made to test another bug. Again, this happened suddenly, and I have no idea what's causing it, but it's been happening in previous projects for some time now.

I also have to force-close Godot.

The error has been happening to me since Godot 4.5, but I'm not entirely sure about this.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0d6dc03f-d31c-43ed-99e8-ce6cd9a62a37

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5ed901c-7411-4702-bfa7-963fd041bb07

### Steps to reproduce

The error occurs without warning when opening any type of context menu.
